long_biography.plain_text:
Brandon D. Baty entered a family enterprise rooted in senior housing and healthcare. Columbia Pacific Management traces its history to his father Daniel Baty, who built and sold large retirement-community operators. Brandon later helped establish Columbia Pacific Advisors, adding real-estate, lending and opportunistic investment strategies to that operating base.

As president, Baty now runs Columbia Pacific Management's day-to-day business affairs. Its international portfolio develops and manages hospitals and senior-living facilities, while affiliated investments extend into remote medicine and Washington wine. He also serves on the Columbia Asia and Remote Medical International boards.
